Do not publish this template as a completed investigation. Replace dates and placeholders, choose an unused note number, and verify the evidence first.

## The question

What decision will these observations inform? State the hypothesis and success/failure criteria before interpreting results.

## What was tested

Record tasks, dataset and permissions, sample counts, baselines, exact model versions, prompts, tool definitions, runtime, dates, repetition strategy, and cost definitions. Distinguish real service calls from simulations.

## What happened

Show actual observations and failed attempts, uncertainty, and measurement limits. Retain source artifacts supporting every number.

## What the evidence suggests

Explain a practical decision and its trade-offs. Use first-person conclusions only after the named author adopts them. Separate interpretation from observed results.

## Reproduce the work

Link a pinned code revision, configuration, permissible inputs, commands, dependencies, budget expectations, and accessible result artifacts. Exclude credentials and private data.

## What remains uncertain

Describe confounders, excluded tasks, missing measurements, and what would change the conclusion.
